sources.prompt: Sprite sheet for a dark fantasy RPG top HUD, hand-illustrated pixel painting in the late 1990s / early 2000s PC RPG tradition, matching the supplied carved limestone and worn bronze frame (style reference only). Flat pure black background. Top: one long horizontal carved-stone lintel with ornamental end caps and a repeatable middle of winding acanthus relief, thin dark-bronze rails, small muted amber studs. Bottom row, left to right: a circular stone-and-bronze portrait medallion ring with four amber studs and two hanging bronze loops; a small horizontal pendant plaque hung from two bronze rings with a recessed dark centre; a small stat plaque with one amber stud on its top edge; a thin EXP groove channel with glowing molten amber fill inside; a hanging oxblood leather tab with a swallowtail bottom under a small carved bracket. Visible deliberate pixel clusters, limited earthy palette, subtle dithering, light from upper left. No text, no icons, no glossy gold, no neon, no soft glows outside pieces.
